blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. Today that second half is written by hand, and the experience of building one strategy never carries to the next. We introduce Strategist, a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks. Each strategy is written as a blueprint,executable code that other strategies can reuse, and together the blueprints form a library. Given a task and a small development set, Strategist retrieves related blueprints, writes candidate strategies, tests them on real samples, and revises them from the results. Every candidate then enters the library, so later tasks build on earlier discoveries. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy (74.7% vs.74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost. Its strategies also transfer to unseen tasks and other models without further search. The part of an AI system that is not improved on its own now does.
blocks.zh: 一个模型只是AI代理系统的一半. 另一半是推论策略:将模型调用变为响应的推理程序. 今天,下半部分是用手写成的,制定战略的经验从来就没有。 我们介绍了战略家,一个在各项任务中发展推论战略的元代理人。 每个策略被写成蓝图,可执行的代码,其他策略可以再用,蓝图一起组成了库. 鉴于一项任务和一套小的发展,战略家检索相关的蓝图,撰写候选战略,在真实样本上进行测试,并从结果中修改. 每位候选人随后进入了图书馆,因此后期的任务建立在更早的发现上. 在30个基准上,战略家在24个基准上击败了最强的基准,并以39%的推论成本与其平均准确度(74.7%对74.0%)相匹配。 其战略也转移到隐形任务和其他模式,无需进一步搜索。 人工智能系统本身没有改进的部分现在有了改进。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Strategist turns strategy design into a search that accumulates knowledge. Top: in each round, an LLM writes new inference strategies as code, runs them, and stores every one, with its measured accuracy and cost, in a library shared across tasks, so later tasks build on what earlier ones found. The models stay frozen; only the strategies change. Bottom: the search matches the strongest baseline (BL) at lower cost, and its strategies work on new tasks and new models without further search. Cost ratios are per-benchmark averages; transfer costs are totals in USD.
blocks.zh: 图1 战略家将战略设计转化为积累知识的搜索. 顶部:在每个回合中,一个LLM会将新的推论策略写成代码,运行这些策略,并以其测量的精度和成本将每一个策略存储在一个共享的任务的库中,所以以后的任务会建立在早期发现的基础之上. 模型保持冻结;只有战略改变。 底部:搜索与最强基线(BL)相匹配,成本较低,其战略在新任务和新模型上工作而无需进一步搜索. 成本比率为每个基准的平均值;转账费用为美元总额。

blocks.en: Section 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 第1节 导言

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Strategy design is per task; Strategist makes it cumulative. By hand and in prior automated search, nothing carries between tasks. Strategist keeps every strategy in a library that the next task starts from.
blocks.zh: 图2 战略设计是每个任务;战略家是累积的。 通过手和之前的自动搜索,任务之间没有任何东西可携带. 战略家将每一个策略都保存在下一个任务开始的图书馆中.

blocks.en: A model is only half of an AI system. The other half is how that model is put to work, and it matters just as much. Everything from the prompt to the reasoning procedure decides how it behaves. Today that second half is designed by people, fixed, one system at a time. Someone writes the prompt, tries it, adjusts it, and once the system works, the design is left as it is. It is the part of the system that never improves on its own.
blocks.zh: 一个模型只是AI系统的一半. 另一半是这个模式是如何运作的,它同样重要。 从即时到推理程序的一切决定它的行为方式. 今天,下半部分是由人设计的,固定的,一次一个系统. 有人写出提示,尝试,调整,一旦系统工作,设计就如原样. 该系统的一部分从未自行改进。

blocks.en:
There is no reason it has to stay that way. The prompts and reasoning procedures that put a model to work are text and code, and agents themselves have become good at writing both. What humans do to design (write, try, adjust) such inference strategies is the natural agentic loop. Such loops have already been shown to evolve programs far beyond their starting point ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) , and AI scientists now run the same loop end to end ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Gottweis et al., 2025 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ) . Designing an inference strategy is the same work with a different object. So why not evolve agentic reasoning itself the same way? Run on far more cases than a person could try,
the loop could outdo what people build by hand.
blocks.zh:
没有理由坚持这样下去。 使模型发挥作用的提示和推理程序是文本和代码,代理商本身也开始善于写作两者. 人类在设计(写作,尝试,调整)这种推论策略时所做的是自然的代理循环. 此类环路已被证明远超其起点(Novikov等人,2025年),AI科学家现在运行同一环路端至终点(Lu等人,2024年;Gottweis等人,2025年;Yamada等人,2025年)。 设计推论策略与不同对象相同. 那么为什么不以同样的方式发展代理推理呢? 跑在远不止一个人可以尝试,
循环可以超越 人通过手建设。

blocks.en: Recent work has begun to automate this loop: searching over strategy designs, as raw code or as assemblies of fixed components ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ; Shang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) ; training controllers that route each input to an existing strategy ( Taparia et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Su et al., 2025 ) ; or optimizing one strategy per task by training, evolution, or iterative refinement ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) . All of them beat hand-designed strategies on individual benchmarks, and all of them stop there. Searching or routing over a fixed set of strategies can never discover a new one. Trained optimizers need to start over for every task. These methods make the design automatic. We want to make it cumulative (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 最近的工作已经开始使这一循环自动化:搜索战略设计,作为原始代码或固定部件的组件(Hu等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年c;Shang等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年a);培训控制员,为现行战略提供每一项投入(Taparia等人,2026年;Yue等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年b;Su等人,2025年b);或通过培训、演化或迭代完善优化每项任务的一个战略(Gao等人,2024年;Li等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2026年;Gao等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年a)。 他们都战胜了个人基准上的手工设计战略,他们都停在那里。 在固定的一套战略上搜索或路径永远无法发现新的战略。 训练有素的优化者需要重新开始每一项任务. 这些方法使设计自动. 我们想让它累积起来(图2).

blocks.en: We start from the representation. Evolving strategies needs a form open enough to express any reasoning procedure and structured enough for later searches to reuse and combine. We introduce the Strategy Blueprint : an executable program with one shared code interface, so any blueprint can serve as a component inside another. New designs are built from old ones, and the library grows as it is used.
blocks.zh: 我们从代表开始。 不断演变的战略需要一种足够开放的表格,以表达任何推理程序,结构上足够以后的搜索再利用和结合. 我们介绍战略蓝图:一个具有一个共享代码界面的可执行程序,因此任何蓝图都可以作为另一个内部的一个组件. 新的设计由旧设计而来,图书馆随使用而增长.

blocks.en:
On this representation we build Strategist , a meta-agent that does not answer questions but designs the strategies that do. It runs the write, try, adjust loop at scale, with frozen models and no training. Given a task and a small development set, it writes candidate strategies as blueprints, runs them on real samples, reads the traces, and revises them against measured accuracy and cost. Before each round it queries a shared library for relevant blueprints and for diverse ones as inspiration.
After each round every candidate
goes back into the library with its
measurements and experience notes.
blocks.zh:
以此为代表,我们建立了战略家,一个不回答问题而设计战略的元代理人。 它运行着写字,尝试,按规模调整循环,有冷冻的模型,没有训练. 考虑到一项任务和一套小的发展,它将候选战略写成蓝图,在真实的样本上运行,读取痕迹,并根据衡量的准确度和成本加以修改。 在每一回合之前,它都会查询一个共用的图书馆,以获取相关的蓝图和各种蓝图作为灵感。
每轮后,每个候选人
带着它回到图书馆
测量和经验说明。

blocks.en: On 30 benchmarks spanning math, code, commonsense, multi-hop QA, knowledge, logic, and recommendation, we compare Strategist against 18 baselines. Strategist wins on 24 of 30, matching the strongest baseline’s average accuracy ( 74.0 % → 74.7 % 74.0\%\!\to\!74.7\% ) at 39% lower cost. The library pays off on its own: on 10 held-out benchmarks, retrieval with no search stays within 2 points of the strongest baseline on all 10 and beats it on 8 ( 77.8 % → 81.4 % 77.8\%\to 81.4\% ). The same strategies, moved to GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5 without changing a line, still beat the baselines there. Each task solved leaves the next one a better place to start. Until now, only the model in an AI system could learn. Now the rest of it can too.
blocks.zh: 在30个涵盖数学,代码,常识,多跳QA,知识,逻辑,以及推荐的基准上,我们比较了战略家和18个基准. 战略家在30分之24获胜, 图书馆靠自己支付:在10个搁置基准中,没有搜索的检索停留在所有10个最强基线的2点以内,在8个基准(77.8% — — 81.4 % — —81.8 % — —81.4 % — —81.4 % ) 上。 同样的策略,移动到GPT-5和双子座-2.5,没有改变线条,仍然比那里的基线高。 每次任务完成后,下一个任务就有一个更好的起点。 直到现在,只有AI系统中的模型才能学习. 现在剩下的也行了

blocks.en: Figure 3 : The Strategy Blueprint is a freeform graph that grows through the library. (a) Two foundations ( chat and agent ) sit at the top. Strategies compose from them and from each other, forming a directed graph whose levels emerge naturally from composition depth. (b) Four protocols govern the graph: every node shares one abstract interface, each node can only call nodes created before it, no cycles are allowed, and no duplicates should exist.
blocks.zh: 图3:"战略蓝图"是一个自由格式的图,通过图书库生长. (a) 两个基金会(聊天和代理)坐到顶端。 战略由它们和彼此组成,形成一个直线图,其水平自然地产生于构成深度。 (b) 四个协议管辖图:每个节点共享一个抽象界面,每个节点只能调用它之前创建的节点,不允许循环,不应存在重复.

blocks.en: Section 2 The Strategy Blueprint
blocks.zh: 第2节 战略蓝图

blocks.en: Every inference strategy, ultimately, is a program. How it is represented determines what an automated designer can build, test, and reuse. Existing work represents strategies as computation graphs ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Zhuge et al., 2024 ) and declarative pipelines ( Khattab et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) , which are composable but can only express pre-defined patterns, or as monolithic code ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , which can express anything but produces isolated strategies. We introduce the Strategy Blueprint : a reasoning flow that specifies how to solve a task (which models to call, in what order, at which tier, and how) using the open interface of code. Every blueprint exposes the same interface, so any can call any other, and a library can grow by composition.
blocks.zh: 每一个推断策略,最终,是一个程序. 如何代表它决定自动设计师能够建造、测试和再利用什么。 现有工作代表了作为计算图(Wu等人,2024年;Zhuge等人,2024年)和申报管道(Khattab等人,2024年;Yue等人,2026年)的战略,它们可调和,但只能表达预先定义的规律,或作为单体编码(Hu等人,2025年),可以表达任何东西,但产生孤立策略. 我们介绍战略蓝图:一种推理流程,其中具体规定如何利用代码的开放界面来解决一项任务(哪些模型可以调用,按什么顺序调用,哪个层次以及如何调用)。 每个蓝图都暴露出相同的界面,所以任何一个都可以调用其他的,一个库可以通过组成来增长.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Strategy blueprint captures reasoning structure. This simplified blueprint example defines the steps, control flow, and the model tier for each step. Prompts are not specified; filling in produces a runnable strategy.
blocks.zh: 图4:战略蓝图抓住推理结构。 这个简化的蓝图示例定义了每个步骤的阶梯,控制流,以及模型级. 未指定提示; 填写生成可运行策略 。

blocks.en: A blueprint is a Python program that captures the structure of a reasoning strategy without the task-specific prompts. For example, one blueprint defines a loop: generate three candidate answers, review each, then majority-vote. Filling in prompts produces a runnable strategy . It has one interface, execute(llm, task) -> str , and is built from two foundations: chat (single- or multi-turn conversation) and agent (with scaffold and tools). See Figure 4 for an example.
blocks.zh: 一个蓝图是一个Python程序,它捕捉一个推理策略的结构,而不包含任务特定提示. 例如,一个蓝图定义了一个循环:生成三个候选答案,每个审查,然后多数投票. 填充提示可以产生一个可运行的策略。 它有一个接口,执行(llm, task) - > str,由两个基础构建:聊天(单回合或多回合对话)和代理(带有脚手架和工具). 例如,见图4。

blocks.en: We allow strategies to route across three model tiers ( fast , balanced , complex ), each in two modes ( nothink and thinking ), mirroring the tiered pricing and effort levels of common model providers. Not every reasoning step needs the same intelligence, so each step can target a different tier. This internal routing is what allows a single strategy to be accurate and cost-efficient at the same time.
blocks.zh: 我们允许战略跨越三个模式层次(快速、平衡、复杂),每个模式分为两种模式(思维和思维),反映共同模式提供者的分级定价和努力水平。 并不是每个推理步骤都需要相同的智力,所以每个步骤可以针对不同的层次. 这种内部的路由方式使得单一战略能够同时准确和具有成本效益.

blocks.en: Blueprints live in a shared library that grows over time. They are added along with their measured performance and experience notes on when it works and when it does not. Because every blueprint exposes the same interface, a new blueprint can use any existing one as a component, so the library compounds: early blueprints build on the two foundations, later ones compose from those, and depth grows naturally (Figure 3 a ). Four protocols govern the library (Figure 3 b ): a shared interface, no forward calls, no cycles, and no duplicates.
blocks.zh: 蓝图生活在一个随着时间推移而成长的共享库中. 它们连同其衡量的业绩和经验说明一起加入,说明何时有效,何时无效。 因为每一个蓝图都暴露出相同的界面,一个新的蓝图可以使用任何现有的一个作为组件,所以库的复合体:早期的蓝图建立在两个基础上,后来的蓝图由这些基础组成,深度自然增长(图3 a). 四条协议规范库(图3b):一个共享接口,没有前方呼叫,没有循环,也没有重复.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : The Strategist four-stage iterative pipeline. Each iteration: (1) Retrieve relevant blueprints and diverse inspiration from the Library; (2) Propose K K candidates as a mix of new , composed , and reuse blueprints paired with task-specific prompts; (3) Evaluate each candidate, seeing full traces on the training set and aggregated scores on validation; (4) Accumulate the underlying blueprints into the library with measurement cards and experience notes.
blocks.zh: 图5:战略家四阶段迭代管道. 每个迭代: (1) 从图书馆获取相关的蓝图和不同的灵感; (2) 提出K K候选人,作为新的、由任务组成的和再利用的蓝图与具体任务提示的组合; (3) 评估每个候选人,在培训集中看到全部痕迹,并在验证时得到汇总的分数; (4) 将基本蓝图与计量卡和经验说明汇入图书馆。

blocks.en: Section 3 Strategist
blocks.zh: 第3节 战略家

blocks.en: Given a task and a small development set, Strategist iteratively retrieves relevant blueprints, proposes K = 5 K{=}5 candidates, evaluates them on real samples, and accumulates the results back into the library (Figure 5 ). After N N iterations, the candidate that beats BL on both the validation and hidden splits by the largest hidden-set margin is returned, or BL itself if none does (Algorithm 1 ).
blocks.zh: 鉴于一项任务和一套小开发,战略家迭代检索了相关的蓝图,提议K= 5K{=}5考生,在真实样本上评价,并将结果累积回库(图5). 在N迭代后,通过最大隐藏设置边距在验证和隐藏分数上击败BL的候选人会被返回,如果没有BL的话,则会返回BL本身(Algorithm 1 ).

blocks.en: The strategist queries the Blueprint Library with a short text prompt. The search is hybrid (TF–IDF plus embedding similarity). Each blueprint carries traits, a measurement card, and experience notes written by previous strategists; the search indexes over all of these, so the strategist finds blueprints by measured behavior and prior analyses, not just structural similarity. Beyond relevant results, the library returns adjacent inspiration (blueprints from other domains or reasoning patterns) to inspire new designs.
blocks.zh: 战略家以短文本提示查询"蓝图库". 搜索为混合(TF-IDF+嵌入相似性). 每个蓝图都带有特征,一个测量卡,以及前战略家写的经验说明;搜索索引覆盖所有这些,因此战略家通过测量行为和前期分析找到蓝图,而不仅仅是结构上的相似性. 除了相关结果外,库会返回相邻的灵感(来自其他域的蓝印或推理模式)来激励新的设计.

blocks.en:
Using the retrieved blueprints and inspiration, the strategist designs new blueprints or composes from existing ones, each paired with task-specific prompts to form candidate strategies. Each blueprint must be one of three kinds: new (a blueprint with no library backbone), composed (a blueprint that wraps or extends an existing one), or reuse (directly applies an existing library blueprint with new prompts). Every iteration includes at least one candidate of each kind,
balancing exploration and exploitation.
blocks.zh:
战略家利用检索到的蓝图和灵感,从现有的蓝图中设计出新的蓝图或作曲,每个蓝图都配有特定任务提示,形成候选战略. 每个蓝图必须是三种类型的之一:新的(一个没有图书馆主干线的蓝图),组成(一个包裹或扩展现有蓝图),或再利用(直接应用一个带有新提示的现有图书馆蓝图). 每个周期至少有一名候选人,
平衡勘探和开发。

blocks.en: The system operates at two levels. At the agent level (inner loop), each candidate strategy processes inputs directly, and the strategist observes the full reasoning trace, execution status, and scores. At the meta level (outer loop), the strategist uses these observations to improve its proposals. The data is split into four parts. The training set : strategies run on these samples and the strategist sees both the scores and the full agent traces. The validation set : strategies also run on these samples, but the strategist sees only the aggregated scores; this mirrors standard train/validation practice and prevents overfitting to the training signal. The hidden set : used to select the winning strategy across all iterations, preventing overfitting to any single iteration. The test set : held out entirely from the search loop and used only for final confirmation.
blocks.zh: 该系统在两个层面运作。 在代理层面(内环),每个候选人策略直接处理输入,策略家观察全部推理追踪,执行状态,以及分数. 在元级(外环),战略家利用这些观察来改进其建议. 数据分为四部分. 训练集:在这些样品上执行战略,战略家既看到分数,也看到全部的物剂痕迹。 验证集:策略也运行在这些样本上,但战略家只看到汇总的分数;这个镜像标准列车/验证惯例,防止与训练信号过于吻合. 隐藏集 : 用于在所有迭代中选择胜方策略,防止过度适应任何单个迭代. 测试设置: 完全脱离搜索循环,仅用于最终确认.

blocks.en: The library stores blueprints, not strategies: it retains the reusable structure while discarding task-specific prompts. This is what enables cross-task transfer. After each iteration, the strategist writes an analysis of each candidate’s structural properties and adds the underlying blueprints to the library with their measurement cards and experience notes, with deduplication.
blocks.zh: 库存储蓝图,而非策略:它保留可重复使用的结构,同时丢弃特定任务提示. 这使得跨任务转移成为可能. 每次迭代后,战略家会写出对每个候选人的结构属性的分析,并用他们的测量卡和经验笔记在库中添加了基础蓝图,并带有重复性.

blocks.en: Section 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 第4节 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate on 40 benchmarks spanning seven categories (Table 2 ). From these, 30 randomly selected benchmarks form the main results and 10 are held out for one-shot retrieval. Each benchmark is split into training, validation, and hidden sets of up to 100 samples each, plus a fixed 200-sample test set.
blocks.zh: 我们评价40项基准,涵盖7个类别(表2)。 从中,30个随机选择的基准构成主要结果,10个用于一弹一弹检索。 每个基准分为训练,验证,隐藏的一组每组最多100个样本,外加固定的200个样本测试组.

blocks.en: Table 1 : 40 benchmarks across seven task categories. We randomly select 30 for the main iterative search and hold out the remaining 10 for one-shot retrieval. Each benchmark is split into training, validation, hidden, and test sets.
blocks.zh: 表1:七个任务类别的40项基准。 我们随机选择30用于主迭代搜索 并保留其余的10用于一拍检索. 每个基准分为培训、验证、隐藏和测试组。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Baselines. Prompting methods call the model directly; agentic methods add tool use or multiple interacting agents. Each baseline runs at all six tier/mode configurations, and we compare against the strongest training split cell.
blocks.zh: 表2:基线。 提示方法直接调用模型;代理方法添加工具使用或多个交互剂. 每个基线都运行在所有6级/模式配置上,我们与最强的训练分裂单元进行比较。

blocks.en: The task models consist of three tiers: Qwen3-0.6B (fast), Qwen3-1.7B (balanced), and Qwen3-4B (complex), each run with thinking off (nothink) or on (thinking), giving six model configs. The strategist is GPT-6, a separate frozen LLM accessed through the Codex CLI; it writes strategies but never answers questions.
blocks.zh: 任务模式由三个层次组成: Qune3-0.6B(快速), Qune3-1.7B(均衡), 和 Qune3-4B(复杂), 每一个与思考(无思考)或思考(思考)一起运行, 给出六个模型配置. 策略家是GPT-6,通过Codex CLI访问的单独冷冻LLM;它写战略但从来不回答问题.

blocks.en: We compare against 18 baselines (Table 2 ), all using the same task models without internet access. They span from direct prompting to multi-agent workflows, and each runs at all six model configurations, giving 18 × 6 = 108 18\times 6=108 cells per benchmark. Our baseline (BL) is the cell most accurate on a benchmark’s training split, scored on the test set. This mirrors deployment: a method is chosen on the small sample at hand, then applied to a larger unseen sample from the same distribution. Our strategy is likewise chosen without seeing the test set.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了18个基线(表2),所有基准都使用相同的任务模式,没有互联网。 它们从直接提示到多代理工作流程,每个都运行在所有六个模型配置上,给出18×6 = 108 18\times 6=108个每个基准的单元格. 我们的基线(BL)是基准训练分数中最准确的单元格,在测试集中得分。 这种镜像部署:在手边的小样本上选择一种方法,然后应用到来自同一分布的更大的未见样本上. 我们的策略同样是在没有看到测试结果的情况下选择的。

blocks.en: We report accuracy and weighted cost. Cost is token usage (input and output) weighted by tier (fast = 1 × =1\times , balanced = 2.83 × =2.83\times , complex = 6.67 × =6.67\times , matching the 0.6B/1.7B/4B parameter ratio), since per-token floating-point operations (FLOPs) scale linearly with the parameter count ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们报告准确性和加权成本。 成本为代用(输入和输出),按阶次加权(快速=1×1×1×时,平衡=2.83×2.83×时,复杂=6.67×6.67×时,匹配0.6B/1.7B/4B参数比),因为每端浮点操作(FLOPs)的尺度线性与参数计数(Kaplan等人,2020年).

blocks.en: Section 5 Results
blocks.zh: 第5节 结果

blocks.en: We run the full Strategist loop on each of the 30 main benchmarks. BL is the cell of the 18 × 6 18\times 6 baseline matrix that is most accurate on the benchmark’s training split; all methods share the same executors, extractor, and 200-sample test split. A strategy wins if it is better than BL on accuracy (by more than 2 points) or on cost (by more than 2%) and worse on neither. Strategist wins on 24 of 30 benchmarks, ties on 2 (MBPP+, MinervaM), trades accuracy for cost on 2 (MedQA, AIME) and loses on 2 (HotpotQA and COPA, at equal accuracy but 9% and 6% higher cost); it cuts weighted cost by more than 2% on 26 of 30 (Figure 7 ; Figure 6 places Ours among all 108 baseline cells; per-benchmark numbers in Appendix C.1 ). On average, Strategist matches BL’s accuracy ( 74.0 % → 74.7 % 74.0\%\to 74.7\% ) while reducing weighted cost by 39 % 39\% (a mean per-benchmark cost ratio of 0.61 × 0.61\times relative to BL).
blocks.zh: 我们运行了30个主要基准中的每一个全战略循环。 BL是18×6 18\times 6基准矩阵的单元格,在基准的训练分拆上最为准确;所有方法都共享相同的执行器,提取器,以及200样测试分拆. 如果在准确度(超过2分)或成本(超过2%)上优于BL,且两者均不如BL,则策略胜出. 战略家在30项基准中,24项胜出,2项(MBPP+,MinervaM),2项(MedQA,AIME)的精准成本交易和2项(HotpotQA和COPA,精确度相同,但成本增加9%和6%);30项基准中,26项基准的加权成本削减了2%以上(图7;图6位) 我们在108个基准细胞中;附录C.1中的每个基准数。 平均来说,战略家比对BL的准确性(74.0%~74.7%~74.0~74%~74.7),而加权成本则比BL降低39 %~39(平均每个基准成本比为0.61×0.61\时间).

blocks.en:
The largest accuracy gains come with large cost cuts: SQuAD v2 ( 73.2 % → 79.1 % 73.2\%\to 79.1\% at 0.23 × 0.23\times cost), TruthfulQA ( + 4.5 +4.5 points), 2WikiMQA ( + 4.0 +4.0 at 0.34 × 0.34\times ), Amazon-Rec ( + 4.0 +4.0 ), SAT-Math ( + 3.6 +3.6 at 0.41 × 0.41\times ), LSAT-AR ( + 3.4 +3.4 ) and LSAT-RC ( + 3.0 +3.0 at 0.50 × 0.50\times ). On benchmarks where the models are near their accuracy ceiling (e.g., MMLU, GSM8K, ASDiv, SciQ, MMLU-STEM-Hard), Strategist keeps accuracy within 2 points of BL and cuts cost instead, by 66–89%.
Of the 24 wins, most come from strategist-designed strategies and and some are from simpler baseline scripts, found during search, that match BL’s accuracy at a lower cost. Strategist is not Pareto-improving everywhere: on MedQA and AIME 2024 it is cheaper ( 0.44 × 0.44\times , 0.77 × 0.77\times ) but 4–5 points less accurate, and on HotpotQA and COPA it matches accuracy at slightly higher cost.
blocks.zh:
最大的精度增益与大幅成本削减有关:SQAD v2(73.2%~79.1%~79.1+to 79.1+x0.23+时间成本),TrealQA(+4.5+4.5点),2WikiMQA(+4.0+4.0+0.34+时间),Amazon-Rec(+4.0+4.0),SAT-Math(+3.6+3.6+0.41+0.41+时间),LSAT-AR(+3.4+3.4)和LSAT-RC(+3.0+3.0+0.50+时间). 在模型接近精确度上限的基准(如MMLU、GSM8K、ASDiv、SciQ、MMLU-STEM-Hard)上,战略家将精确度控制在BL的2点以内,削减成本为66-89%。
在24个赢家中,大多数来自战略设计的战略,有些来自搜索时发现的更简单的基线脚本,这些脚本与BL的准确性相匹配,成本较低. 战略家并非无处不在改进:在MedQA和AIME 2024上,它更便宜(0.44 × 0.44\时,0.77× 0.77\时),但4–5点不准确,在HotpotQA和COPA上,它以略高的成本匹配精度.

blocks.en: The 30-benchmark main run grew the library to 1,865 1{,}865 blueprints. We test if a future task can skip the full search: on 10 held-out benchmarks, the strategist queries the final strategies of the main searches (not the full library) once, instantiates the top-5 retrieved blueprints for the task, measures each on up to 300 development questions, and runs the chosen one (the most accurate candidate cheaper than BL if within 2 points of the best, otherwise the best) on the test set, with no search. It stays within 2 points of BL’s accuracy on all 10 and above it on 8 ( 77.8 % → 81.4 % 77.8\%\to 81.4\% on average) and wins on 6 (Table 4 ); on BoolQ, SIQA, and DROP it is more accurate but costlier than their very cheap BL ( 1.0 1.0 – 4.9 4.9 k per sample), and on QUALITY it costs 7 % 7\% more at equal accuracy. Its per-benchmark average cost (as in Figure 7 ) is 0.77 × 0.77\times BL’s without BoolQ and SIQA, whose single-call BL puts their ratios at 32 × 32\times and 4.5 × 4.5\times .
blocks.zh: 30个基准主跑将图书馆发展到1,865 1{,}865个蓝图. 我们测试一个未来的任务是否能够跳过全面搜索:在10个搁置的基准上,战略家询问一次主搜索(而不是完整库)的最终策略,即刻将任务前5位检索到的蓝图,对每个最多300个发展问题进行测量,并在测试集上运行(如果在最佳的2分以内,最准确的候选人比BL便宜),没有搜索. 它在所有10个以上(平均为77.8%~81.4%~81.4 %)的BL精度范围内保持2点,在6个以上(表4)的BoulQ、SIQA和DROP上保持2点,比它们非常便宜的BL(每个样本1.01.0–4.9 k)更准确但成本更高,在QUALITY上,其精度在同样准确度上高出7%~7 % 。 它的每个基准平均成本(如图7所示)是0.77×0.77\Times BL没有BoulQ和SIQA,其单调BL将其比率定为32×32\Times和4.5×4.5\Times。

blocks.en:
A strategy is most useful if it captures structure of the task rather than idiosyncrasies of the executor it was searched on. We re-run Strategist -discovered strategies, without any modification to the blueprint code or its prompts, on two model families the strategist never saw during search: OpenAI GPT-5 (nano, mini, full) and Google Gemini-2.5 (flash-lite, flash).
On GPT-5 the strategies win on 7 of 10 benchmarks and lose on 3 (ASDiv, HellaSwag, MinervaM: within 2 points of the baseline but costlier); on Gemini they win on 8 of 10, with SQuAD2 and MinervaM mixed (cheaper but less accurate). Aggregate cost in USD drops by 35 % 35\% and 40 % 40\% . Part of the GPT-5 margin comes from baseline workflows that break on the new backend ( self_refine and multi_agent_debate return malformed answers there) while the discovered strategies run unchanged. That a Qwen3-discovered blueprint carries over at all shows that Strategist captures the structure of the task, not executor-specific tricks.
blocks.zh:
战略如果能抓住任务的结构,而不是被搜索的执行者的特异性,就最有用. 我们重新运行了Strategist——发现的战略,没有修改蓝图代码或其提示,在两个模范家庭中,战略家在搜索过程中从未见到过:OpenAI GPT-5(nano,迷你,全)和Google双子座2.5(flash-lite,闪光).
在GPT-5上,战略以10个基准中的7个取胜,在3个基准上输(ASDiv、HelaSwag、MinervaM:在基线的2个点内但成本更高);在双子座上,战略以10个基准中的8个取胜,SQuAD2和MinervaM混合(便宜但准确性较低)。 以美元计的总成本下降了35%、35%和40%。 部分GPT-5比值来自在新的后端断开的基线工作流程(self_refine and multip_agent_debate return reformed sequence),而发现的策略运行不变. Qune3发现的蓝图 显示战略家掌握了任务的结构 而不是执行者特有的诡计

blocks.en: Section 6 Analysis
blocks.zh: 第6节 分析

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows one strategy (accuracy driven) designed for the Amazon-Rec task: it builds a user profile with cheap calls, extracts brand and category signals, and conditionally routes to a multi-agent debate only for users with shifting preferences, before merging and auditing the top picks. The branching is cheap deterministic logic that decides which inputs deserve the expensive call, so the strategy spends its capacity where it actually changes the answer rather than uniformly across all inputs. The conditional routing, the merge weighting, and the audit step all emerged from iterative proposals against measured accuracy. Because the result is plain Python, a user can read and edit it directly, and the call is structural, which is hard to do with prompt-bag methods or training-based alternatives.
blocks.zh: 图8显示了为Amazon-Rec任务设计的一种策略(精确驱动):它用廉价的呼叫,提取品牌和类别信号构建用户配置,有条件地仅为有转变偏好的用户通往多代理辩论的路径,然后合并和审计顶级选择. 分支是廉价的决定性逻辑,它决定哪些投入值得昂贵的号召,因此,战略将其能力花在实际改变答案的地方,而不是在所有投入中统一。 有条件的路由、合并权重和审计步骤都来自反复提议,而不是精确度。 因为结果是Plain Python,所以用户可以直接阅读和编辑它,而调用是结构性的,这很难用即时袋方法或基于训练的替代品.

blocks.en: The strategist sees training traces and validation scores at every iteration and could fit noise in them; if it did, the training curve would pull away from the hidden curve. Figure 9 plots, per iteration, the mean accuracy of that iteration’s five candidates on each split, averaged over the 30 main benchmarks. The curves move together and the training–hidden gap stays between 1.2 1.2 and 2.5 2.5 points, so the proposals do not drift away from data the strategist never sees. Selection is a different matter: the final strategy is chosen for being best on the hidden split, and part of that is luck. Across the 30 benchmarks the pick is 4.3 4.3 points above BL on hidden but 0.7 0.7 on test (BL itself moves by 0.5 0.5 ). The test split, on which nothing is chosen, is the only unbiased estimate, and it is what every table reports.
blocks.zh: 战略家在每个迭代都看到训练痕迹和验证分数,并且可以把噪音放进去;如果这样的话,训练曲线就会从隐藏的曲线上拉开. 图9 按重迭计算,重迭的五名候选人每分期的平均准确度平均为30个主要基准。 曲线移动在一起,训练-隐藏差距保持在1.2 1.2至2.5 2.5点之间,因此提议不会偏离战略家从未看到的数据。 选择是一个不同的问题:选择最后的策略是为了在隐藏的分裂上表现得最好,其中一部分是运气. 在30个基准中,选取的BL比BL高4.34.3分,试取0.7分(BL本身移动0.50.5)。 测试分裂,没有选择任何东西,是唯一没有偏见的估计,也是每个表格报告的情况。

blocks.en: Section 8 Related Work
blocks.zh: 第8节 有关工作

blocks.en: LLM agents span chain-of-thought (CoT) and self-consistency reasoning ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) , deliberate search ( Yao et al., 2023a ) , tool-use loops ( Yao et al., 2023b ; Schick et al., 2023 ) , verbal self-reflection ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , multi-agent conversation ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , and formal representations from state machines to declarative compilation to optimizable graphs ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Khattab et al., 2024 ; Zhuge et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) . The strategy layer (how models are called, in what order, and with what verification) has become the central design bottleneck; Strategist automates its design. (An extended discussion of related work is in Appendix D .)
blocks.zh: LLM代理跨越思维链(CoT)和自我一致性推理(Wei等人,2022年;Wang等人,2023年),故意搜索(姚等人,2023年a),工具使用循环 (Yao等人,2023b;Schick等人,2023),口头自我反省(Shinn等人,2023),多代理谈话(Wu等人,2023),以及国家机器正式表述为可选择图的申报汇编(Wu等人,2024;Khattab等人,2024;Zhuge等人,2024;Yue等人,2026). 战略层(如何命名模型,按什么顺序,用什么核查)已经成为中心设计瓶颈;战略家将其设计自动化. (有关工作的详细讨论见附录D.)

blocks.en: Structure-search methods write strategies as raw code ( Hu et al., 2025 ) or compose them from fixed components or predefined modules ( Zhang et al., 2025c ; Shang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) ; the first yields isolated programs, the second bounds what can be discovered. Optimization methods refine one strategy per task, by reinforcement learning ( Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) or by LLM-driven evolution and refinement ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) , and start over on the next task. Routing methods select among existing strategies without building them ( Taparia et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Strategist instead allows freeform creation via the Strategy Blueprint, needs no training, builds strategies itself, and routes across model tiers in each strategy.
blocks.zh: 结构研究方法将策略写成原始代码(Hu等人,2025年)或由固定组件或预定义模块组成(Zhang等人,2025年c; Shang等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年a;第一个生产孤立方案,第二个范围是可以发现的东西。 优化方法通过强化学习(李等人,2024年;张等人,2026年;高等人,2025年)或LLM驱动的进化和完善(高等人,2024年;刘等人,2025a年),细化每个任务一个策略,重新开始下一个任务. 在不构建这些战略的情况下,在现有的战略中选择骑行方法(Taparia等人,2026年;Yue等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年b)。 相反,战略家允许通过 " 战略蓝图 " 自由创建,不需要培训,制定战略本身,以及在每个战略中跨模范层级的路线。

blocks.en: Cross-task transfer has been studied through meta-learning ( Finn et al., 2017 ; Hospedales et al., 2022 ) , neural architecture search ( Elsken et al., 2019 ) , and prompt optimization ( Yang et al., 2024 ) ; in the LLM-agent setting, ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) and Voyager ( Wang et al., 2024 ) accumulate experience or skills, and lifelong-agent learning has been formalized as a direction ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . Existing automated design methods ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) still largely optimize per task. Strategist maintains a shared blueprint library that grows with every task, providing both exploitation (relevant components) and exploration (diverse inspiration); to our knowledge, the first automated strategy-design system that accumulates knowledge from one task to the next.
blocks.zh: 通过元学习(Finn等人,2017年;Hospedales等人,2022年),神经架构搜索(Elsken等人,2019年),以及即时优化(Yang等人,2024年)等方法研究了跨任务转移;在LLM代理设定中,ExpeL(赵等人,2024年)和Voyager(Wang等人,2024年)积累经验或技能,终生代理学习被正式确定为方向(郑等人,2025年). 现有的自动化设计方法(胡等人,2025年;张等人,2025年c)仍然基本优化每个任务. 战略家维持一个共同的蓝图库,随每项任务而发展,既提供开发(相关组成部分),又提供探索(多样化灵感);对我们的知识来说,这是第一个从一项任务到另一项任务积累知识的自动化战略设计系统。

blocks.en: Section 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 第9节 结论

blocks.en: We presented Strategist , a meta-agent that designs inference strategies as freeform executable programs on a layered framework, the Strategy Blueprint, and grows a shared Blueprint Library across tasks. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist -designed strategies match or beat most strongest baselines on accuracy while running at substantially lower cost, and the discovered strategies transfer to backends the strategist never searched on. We view freeform strategy design over an accumulating library as a step toward inference systems that get better the more they are used.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了战略师, 一个元代理设计推论策略, 在一个分层框架, 在30项基准上,战略师设计的战略在精确度上与最强的基线相匹配或击败,同时以低得多的成本运行,发现的战略转移到后端,战略师从未搜索过。 我们认为,自由式战略设计相对于一个积累的库来说,是迈向推断系统的一个步骤,这些系统的使用越多越好。

blocks.en: A.1 Pseudocode for the Strategist Design Loop
blocks.zh: A.1 战略设计圈的Pseudocode

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 formalizes the four-stage iterative pipeline described in Section 3 . Inputs are a task description 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , a development set D D split into feedback/validation/hidden subsets, the current shared blueprint library ℒ \mathcal{L} , and the number of iterations N N . Each iteration runs four steps: (i) the strategist queries ℒ \mathcal{L} for the most relevant blueprints and a set of adjacent-domain inspirations; (ii) the strategist proposes K K candidate strategies, balanced across the kinds new / composed / reuse and the targets accuracy / efficiency / balanced ; (iii) each candidate is executed on D D and scored on accuracy and cost; (iv) the strategist writes experience notes summarizing what worked and what failed, and the candidates plus their measurement cards are written back to ℒ \mathcal{L} with structural deduplication. The reference baseline b b (the baseline cell most accurate on the training split, run with its exact code) is evaluated alongside the candidates in the first iteration. After N N iterations, every candidate is compared with b b question by question on the validation and hidden splits; among the candidates that beat b b under the 2% rule on both (better by more than 2 points in accuracy or 2% in cost, worse on neither), the one with the largest hidden-set accuracy gain is returned as s ∗ s^{*} , and b b itself if none qualifies. The updated library ℒ ′ \mathcal{L}^{\prime} is carried forward for future tasks.

blocks.en: All strategies and baselines run as 0-shot generation: the executor LLM produces a free-form response and an answer extractor parses the final answer from the trace. The extractor is benchmark-aware (multiple-choice letter, integer, LaTeX numeric, span, or yes/no) and is the same across Strategist , all baselines, and all five comparison frameworks, so reported accuracy differences reflect strategy choices rather than scoring asymmetries.

blocks.zh: 所有基线运行在相同的Quen3执行器和相同的OpenHands工具沙盒上(只有终端工具+FileEditorToole),没有互联网接入,与战略策略相同. 每个基线在六级/模式配置的每一个配置上都得到独立评价,但基线并不是在一个运行内跨级的内部路线;在一个策略内混合阶梯的能力是设计空间战略搜索的一部分,BL是训练拆分上最精确的单配置单元格.

blocks.en: A.3 Data Split and Scaling
blocks.zh: A.3 数据分割和缩放

blocks.en: Every benchmark is partitioned into four disjoint subsets: training , validation , hidden , and test . The training set is what the strategist sees in full, including per-sample reasoning traces, when proposing the next iteration’s slate. The validation set is also evaluated each iteration but only aggregate scores are visible, mirroring standard train/val practice. The validation and hidden sets are used to pick the final strategy across all N N iterations (Algorithm 1 ); the hidden set is never shown to the strategist; in particular, experience notes written back to the library are derived from training-set traces only, so hidden-set signal cannot leak across iterations or to future tasks. The test set is held out from the search loop entirely and is used only for the final number reported in the main text.
blocks.zh: 每个基准被分成四个脱节子集:训练、验证、隐藏和测试。 训练集是战略家在提出下集时所充分看到的,包括每个样本的推理痕迹。 验证集也在每个迭代中进行评价,但只可见汇总分数,镜像标准列车/val惯例. 验证和隐藏集用于选择跨越所有N型迭代(Algorithm 1 )的最终策略;隐藏集从不向战略家显示;特别是,写回库的经验说明只来自训练集的痕迹,因此隐藏集的信号不能在迭代之间泄露,也不能泄露到未来的任务. 测试集在搜索循环中完全保持,仅用于正文中报告的最终编号.

blocks.en:
The development rows of each benchmark come from a separate development pool (300 rows where available), drawn deterministically with a fixed seed and split into training, validation, and hidden sets of 100 100 rows each; benchmarks with smaller pools scale all three down proportionally, and AIME 2024 and Amazon-Rec, whose questions are about 10 × 10\times longer to solve, use 50 50 rows per split. Where a benchmark’s own pool was too small, it was extended: COPA and SVAMP with rows from their official training data, and AIME with the 299 problems of AIME 2014–2023.
The test set is around the first 200 200 rows of each benchmark’s test file, disjoint from all development rows and never seen during search. Six benchmarks have fewer questions due to limit data.
Splits are deterministic, so reruns and ablations operate identically.

每个基准的开发行来自一个单独的开发池(如有300行),用固定的种子绘制定型,并分成训练,验证,以及隐藏的每组100行;使用较小的池规模大小的基准按比例降低所有三个,以及AIME 2024和Amazon-Rec,它们的问题约10×10\x10xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 在基准本身的集合太小的情况下,它被扩展: COPA和SVAMP从官方培训数据中排出,AIME则从AIME 2014–2023年的299个问题中排出.
测试集围绕每个基准测试文件的前200行,与所有开发行脱节,搜索时从未见过. 由于数据有限,六个基准的问题较少。

blocks.en: A.4 Search, Library, and Models
blocks.zh: A.4 搜索、图书馆和模型

blocks.en: Each iteration proposes K = 5 K=5 candidate strategies; the search runs for N = 10 N=10 iterations per benchmark. Every iteration must include at least one candidate of each kind ( new , composed , reuse ) and of each target ( accuracy : beat BL’s accuracy within its cost; efficiency : hold its accuracy at lower cost; balanced ); slates that violate this rule, deduplicate a recent candidate, or omit required JSON fields are rejected and the strategist is re-prompted. The strategist is shown the baseline matrix measured on the training split (every baseline at all six configurations, with BL highlighted) and the 2% rule by which candidates are judged; it keeps one session across iterations, so later iterations send only the new results. Each LLM call from a strategy uses max_tokens=16384 . A full search evaluates about 60 candidates per benchmark ( K = 5 K{=}5 per iteration plus the reference and repairs), each on all three development splits, roughly 20,000 20{,}000 candidate-sample executions for a benchmark with 100 100 rows per split, plus about 135 135 k prompt tokens and 45 45 k response tokens for the strategist (about 10 10 k prompt tokens per iteration), so the search dominates the per-task cost and amortises across future tasks via library reuse (Section 5 ).

blocks.en: Two blueprints are considered duplicates if their execute function bodies hash to the same value after task-specific string literals (prompts, format instructions) are elided; this is computed over the Python AST so that whitespace and comment changes do not produce spurious distinctions. Duplicate proposals are rejected at submission time and not added to the library.

blocks.en: Each iteration the strategist returns Python code (the candidate strategies) followed by a JSON block describing the slate. The JSON has six required fields per candidate ( name , kind , target , tier_mode_anchors , why , builds_on ) and an optional prompts field that replaces a blueprint’s prompt texts for this task, plus three search-side fields ( search_queries , read_cards , experience ). A non-fatal AST audit checks that builds_on matches the imports in the code block; warnings are fed into the next iteration’s prompt rather than killing the run.

blocks.en: After the 30 main searches, the library contained 1,865 1{,}865 blueprints (deduplicated by structural hash) with measurement cards (cards are written only after a blueprint has been evaluated at least once). Of these, the strategist chose only those with relevance scores above a fixed threshold during retrieval; on average, 5 5 relevance hits and 5 5 adjacent inspirations were returned per query.

blocks.en: Large language models have rapidly evolved from single-call question answerers into multi-step agent systems. Chain-of-thought prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) and self-consistency decoding ( Wang et al., 2023 ) showed that intermediate reasoning steps improve accuracy on complex tasks. Tree of Thoughts ( Yao et al., 2023a ) extended this to deliberate search over reasoning paths. ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023b ) interleaved reasoning with tool use, and Toolformer ( Schick et al., 2023 ) taught models to call external APIs autonomously. Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) introduced verbal self-reflection as a feedback mechanism. Multi-agent frameworks such as AutoGen ( Wu et al., 2023 ) enabled conversational collaboration among multiple LLM agents. Formal representations for these systems range from state machines ( Wu et al., 2024 ) to declarative compilation ( Khattab et al., 2024 ) to optimizable computational graphs ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) . A recent survey ( Yue et al., 2026 ) organizes this landscape as agentic computation graphs, distinguishing static, pre-execution, and in-execution optimization. As these systems grow more complex, the strategy layer that determines how models are called, in what order, and with what verification has become the central design bottleneck. Strategist addresses this bottleneck by automating the design of the strategy layer itself.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型从单调问答器迅速发展为多步代理系统. 思绪链提示 (Wei等人,2022年)和自我一致性解码(Wang等人,2023年)表明中间推理步骤提高了复杂任务的准确性. 《思想之树》(Yao等人,2023年a)将此扩展为对推理路径的蓄意搜索。 ReAct (Yao et al., 2023b) 与工具使用交互的推理, Toolformer (Schick et al., 2023) 教模型自主调用外部API. Reflexion(Shinn等人,2023年)引入了口头自我反射作为反馈机制. AutoGen(Wu等人,2023年)等多代理框架使得多个LLM代理之间能够展开对话合作. 这些系统的正式表述范围从国机(Wu等人,2024年)到申报汇编(Khattab等人,2024年)到可选择计算图表(Zhuge等人,2024年). 最近的一项调查(Yue et al., 2026)将这一景观组织为代理计算图,区分静态,预执行,执行中优化. 随着这些系统日益复杂,决定模型如何被调用,以何种顺序,以及核查方式成为中心设计瓶颈的战略层. 战略家通过将战略层本身的设计自动化来解决这个瓶颈.

blocks.en: Structure search methods write strategies as raw code ( Hu et al., 2025 ) or compose them from fixed components ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) or predefined modules ( Shang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) ; the first yields isolated programs, the second bounds what strategies can be discovered. Optimization methods refine one strategy per task, by reinforcement learning ( Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) or by LLM-driven evolution and refinement ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) , and start over on the next task. Routing methods train controllers to select among existing strategies ( Taparia et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) without constructing them ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Strategist differs by allowing freeform creation through the Strategy Blueprint, requiring no training, constructing strategies itself, and routing across model tiers within each strategy.
blocks.zh: 结构搜索方法将策略写成原始代码(Hu et al.,2025)或从固定组件(Zhang et al.,2025c)或预定义模块(Sang et al.,2025;Zhang et al.,2025a)中编译;第一个输出孤立程序,第二个限定可以发现的策略. 优化方法通过强化学习(李等人,2024年;张等人,2026年;高等人,2025年)或LLM驱动的进化和完善(高等人,2024年;刘等人,2025a年),细化每个任务一个策略,重新开始下一个任务. 运行方法训练控制员在现有战略中进行选择(Taparia等人,2026年;Yue等人,2025年),而不建造这些战略(Zhang等人,2025年b)。 战略家的不同之处在于,通过《战略蓝图》允许免费创建,不需要培训,制定战略本身,以及在每个战略中跨越模范层级。

blocks.en: Transferring knowledge across tasks has been studied through meta-learning ( Finn et al., 2017 ; Hospedales et al., 2022 ) , neural architecture search ( Elsken et al., 2019 ) , and prompt optimization ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . In the LLM agent setting, ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) extracts reusable insights from agent experiences, Voyager ( Wang et al., 2024 ) grows a skill library as it explores new environments, and recent work has formalized this direction as lifelong learning for LLM agents ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . Despite this, automated system design methods ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) still optimize per task independently. Strategist maintains a shared library of blueprints and their measured properties that grows with every task, providing both relevant components (exploitation) and diverse inspiration from other tasks (exploration). To our knowledge, it is the first system for automated strategy design that accumulates knowledge across tasks.
blocks.zh: 通过元学习(Finn等人,2017年;Hospedales等人,2022年),神经架构搜索(Elsken等人,2019年),以及即时优化(Yang等人,2024年),对跨任务的知识转移进行了研究. 在LLM代理设定中,ExpeL(Zhao等人,2024年)从代理经验中提取了可重复使用的见解,Voyager(Wang等人,2024年)在探索新环境时发展了一个技能库,最近的工作将这个方向正式定为LLM代理的终身学习(Zheng等人,2025年). 尽管如此,自动化系统设计方法(Hu et al.,2025;Zhang et al.,2025c)仍然独立优化每个任务. 战略家维持着一个由蓝图及其测量属性组成的共享库,它们随每项任务而增长,既提供相关组件(开发),也提供来自其他任务(探索)的不同灵感. 据我们所知,这是第一个在各项任务中积累知识的自动化战略设计系统。
